thirdTaskPostEditCaseMismatches.command:
cd /workspace && python - <<'EOF'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp')
from django.conf import settings
settings.configure(
    TEMPLATES=[{
        'BACKEND': 'django.template.backends.django.DjangoTemplates',
        'DIRS': ['/tmp'],
        'APP_DIRS': False,
        'OPTIONS': {'libraries': {'testlib': 'mytags.testlib'}},
    }],
)
import django; django.setup()
from django.template import Template, Context

cases = [
    ("A no-kw default", '{% load testlib %}{% hello %}', 'hello world'),
    ("B kw w/ default", '{% load testlib %}{% hello greeting="hi" %}', 'hi world'),
    ("C dup kw", '{% load testlib %}{% hi greeting="hi" greeting="hello" %}', "'hi' received multiple values for keyword argument 'greeting'"),
    ("D missing kw", '{% load testlib %}{% hi %}', "'hi' did not receive value(s) for the argument(s): 'greeting'"),
    ("E kw w/o default", '{% load testlib %}{% hi greeting="yo" %}', 'yo world'),
    ("F bad kw", '{% load testlib %}{% hi nope="x" %}', "'hi' received unexpected keyword argument 'nope'"),
    ("G incl kw w/ default", '{% load testlib %}{% inc greeting="yo" %}', 'INCL: yo world'),
    ("H incl dup kw", '{% load testlib %}{% inc greeting="yo" greeting="zz" %}', "'inc' received multiple values for keyword argument 'greeting'"),
    ("I incl bad kw", '{% load testlib %}{% inc nope="x" %}', "'inc' received unexpected keyword argument 'nope'"),
]
ok = True
for name, src, expected in cases:
    try:
        out = Template(src).render(Context()).strip()
        status = "OK" if out == expected else "MISMATCH"
        print(name, status, "->", repr(out))
    except Exception as e:
        status = "OK" if expected in str(e) else "MISMATCH"
        print(name, status, "->", type(e).__name__, e)
    ok = ok and status == "OK"
print("ALL OK" if ok else "FAILURES PRESENT")
EOF
